reviews.text: It was ok. One of those gets that tries to get $$$ and recommends unnecessary things. If you’re a pet owner on a budget, this probably isn’t the place to just get a quick booster shot. They made me contact my old vets myself while I was there to confirm info already documented in my pets chart, which most places would have their receptionists do that work. Also had me administer an oral booster shot/ liquid thing myself which for the steep costs here isn’t ideal. I could have ordered stuff online and done it myself for a fraction of the cost if I knew I’d be doing receptionist and vet work.

We are so grateful for all the love and care Dr. Dowell and all the vet tech’s provide to us! My Frenchie recently had surgery there for a mast cell tumor removal, and they did a wonderful job at keeping us low stress during a difficult time.

Amazing staff
Love for the animals
Reasonable pricing
Doesn’t force treatment plans but gives options
Thanks for the top rating, Monica! We're happy to know you enjoyed your time with us. We can't wait to see you and your pet again!

I have been meaning to leave a review for a while, Dr. Fritz and her team are absolutely amazing. They are always so kind and patient with our animals and we are so happy to have them in our animals lives!
I would also like to mention how compassionate their staff is, I called yesterday to ask for some guidance about how to handle the passing of a family members pet, the front staff explained the process in a very kind manner and treated a sad situation with sympathy. You can tell they all feel passionately about their patients and honestly, what more could you want from a vet? 10/10
Everyone at Amici took great care of my cat. Kiki! He was seen by Dr. Hare, who was wonderful with my cat, and patiently answered all of my questions!

Dr. Fritz is simply the best. She has cared for three of our dogs, and we trust her completely. We have always valued her diagnoses and advice, and we cannot thank her enough for the professionalism, compassion, and care she showed us during difficult times.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Christine! We're glad you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
The staff is exceptional - patient, empathetic, and thorough - we could not ask for better care for our basset!

We have been with AMICI over 10 years and have gotten to know the doctors and staff very well and vise versa, everyone knows my kelpies. You can tell how much everyone truly loves and respects animals right when you walk in. One of my dogs even struts when he arrives and usually makes everyone smile and say hi when we walk in the door.

It’s a great atmosphere and I have no problem dropping them off for procedures as needed, I feel very comfortable leaving my babies in AMICI’s care. They have certainly earned my trust and even though I moved an hour away, I do not intend to find another vet. The AMICI team is well worth the drive and time.
Your 5-star rating means a lot to us. We're thrilled you had a positive experience with our team.
Stella and I are in good hands at Amici Pet Hospital. We love Dr. Fritz and every technician that has ever helped us, This is a great choice if you are looking for a veteriarian!

Great staff. Everyone treats our animals like they are so excited to see them and they are their favorite animal that they’ve only read about to that point. Just so happy to see them and be able to treat them.
Thanks for the top rating! We're happy to know you had a positive experience with us.

Dr. Hare has been guiding us in the process of caring for our African Fat-Tailed Gecko for a few years since my wife and I moved to San Diego. Our little buddy “Roman” just passed away a couple days ago, but he was happy, healthy, and thriving for a lot longer than his species’ life expectancy dictated he would be on this earth. I directly attribute Roman’s high energy and great health as a hyper-geriatric gecko to the expertise, commitment, and compassion that Dr. Hare showed. Roman will always be in our hearts… and later on, when we adopt a new exotic four-legged friend we won’t go anywhere else. Thank you so much, Dr. Hare!… we appreciate you so much more than can be expressed in this review.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive rating. Thank you for choosing us!
Absolutely the  best Vet for your pets, excellent Drs, & Staff, Compasionate & dedicated to healing & also excellent preventative care. My & my family's Pet Vet hospital since 2017. Wonderful People.
Tareq, we appreciate the 5-star review! It's great to know you had a wonderful visit. We hope to welcome you and your pet back in the future!
Dr. Fritz at Amici Pet Hospital was incredibly kind, knowledgeable, thoughtful, and thorough, and we look forward to seeing her for our Teddy's future veterinary needs.
Dr Jake Hare has been so amazing to our three bunnies, Toes, Pinot Grigio, and Thumper. He is so kind and smart, and always answered our questions. Kyla is always amazing, accommodating and kind.
